## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M13 - AI Agent Orchestration.

## Technical Scope

- Engine: Python/FastAPI orchestration runtime configured via YAML
- UI: web frontend for assistant lifecycle management and testing
- Manager and services integration patterns for controlled enterprise deployments
- External dependencies may include search engines, triple stores, object storage, and authentication services
- Current deliverable stage emphasizes architecture and implementation readiness

## Run Guidance

Deploy Jana UI with connected Jana Engine/Services backends as documented in module repositories

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
